title: Four-coordinate Boolean predicate
statement: For a sign assignment $x\in\{−1,1\}^{4}$, the predicate holds if either $x_2=x_3=-1$, or the signs are weakly decreasing in coordinate order, or they are weakly increasing in coordinate order. Here the two monotonicity conditions use the usual order on $\{−1,1\}$.
